Efficient Vector Search over High-Dimensional Graph Indices

Abstract: Approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search in metric spaces has become the backbone of modern neural retrieval and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines. Existing Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) graph indices suffer from substantial memory footprints during billion-scale scaling.

In this paper, we propose Compressed Hierarchical Navigable Small Worlds (C-HNSW), a novel index quantization scheme that interleaves product quantization with selective edge pruning. Our experimental evaluation across deep1b and sift1b benchmarks demonstrates a 4.2x reduction in index memory with negligible recall degradation (less than 0.5% drop at top-10 recall).
